title: From Narrow Unlearning to Emergent Misalignment: Causes, Consequences, and Containment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to ambiguous context questions involving different religious identities from the BBQ dataset (Religion category) using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect whether the response relies on stereotypes or properly refuses/remains unbiased.
Evaluating model responses to prompts from the ToxiGen dataset (Women category) using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify whether the generated output contains toxic or biased content.
